newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler to invest $75 million in engine plant.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to invest $75 million in engine plant.

text.p: Chrysler Corp. has agreed to invest $75 million into its Mound Road Engine Plant in Detroit as a part of the tentative settlement of a month-long strike, United Auto Workers Local 51 said Friday.
Chrysler has declined to comment on the tentative agreement until it is ratified.
In a document handed out to more than 1,800 Local 51 members voting Friday on the pact, the union said Chrysler has agreed to install a new engine block production line at the plant.
The information sheet also said drive shaft production -- a major bone of contention in the strike -- will remain at the plant.
Industry analysts, however, have said they are confident that Chrysler prevailed in its demand that the drive shaft production be at least temporarily shifted to an outside supplier.
Workers are expected to vote on the pact following a briefing on the tentative agreement Friday morning. Chrysler's stock rose 12.5 cents to $30.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
